title: Earth mass expression
description: Essential: Student correctly derives or states Earth mass as M = gR²/G using surface gravity relation.

title: Angular velocity calculation
description: Important: Student correctly computes angular velocity ω = θ/t from given rotation angle and time.

title: Orbital period derivation
description: Essential: Student obtains period T = 2π/ω = 2πt/θ using relationship between period and angular velocity.

title: Force balance equation
description: Important: Student sets up Newton's law: GMm/(R+H)² = m(4π²/T²)(R+H) for circular orbit.

title: Altitude solution
description: Essential: Student solves for orbital altitude H = ∛(gR²t²/θ²) - R by substituting M and T.

title: Units consistency check
description: Optional: Student verifies dimensional consistency of final expressions or includes proper units.

title: Incorrect radius usage
description: Pitfall: Student uses Earth radius R instead of orbital radius (R+H) in gravitational force expression.

title: Sign or algebra error
description: Pitfall: Student makes algebraic mistakes in solving for H, such as incorrect exponent handling or root extraction.
